intent: Show the attachment's secondary details, such as its type, size or upload status, on one muted line.
typical_uses: The file type and size under the name
The progress or the failure reason of an upload

dont_use_when.situation: The supporting text of a card that is not a file

invariants.text: The description renders a span laid out as a block in the small meta type size and var(--muted-foreground) color; it never wraps and cuts overflowing text with an ellipsis.
While the ancestor Attachment's `state` is `error`, the description is drawn in var(--danger).

anti_patterns.dont: Write a long failure explanation into the description
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep it to one short line, since it is cut with an ellipsis, and show the full explanation elsewhere

bad.title: A description outside AttachmentContent
bad.why: AttachmentDescription belongs inside AttachmentContent, which is what lets it shrink and truncate and what the root's padding waits for.
